name: Xianning

queries.query: Xianning China official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry natural resources Xianning
queries.result: First-party discovery found the Xianning Municipal Bureau of Natural Resources and Urban-Rural Development portal, Hubei Natural Resources Department notices describing Xianning's Tianditu public geospatial platform and property-map reform, and an official Xianning land-trading map route. No anonymous citywide cadastral feature service was verified.

queries.result: First-party discovery found the Xianning natural-resources portal with cadastral-map and cadastral-survey complaint contacts, and Hubei official notices stating that Xianning integrated more than 600,000 historical property records and uses real-estate unit codes in its internal property-map workflow. The public Tianditu and planning-map routes did not yield an anonymous cadastral feature response.

officialSources.publisher: Xianning Municipal Bureau of Natural Resources and Urban-Rural Development
officialSources.observation: Official local custodian portal. It identifies the bureau and lists a real-estate registration center contact and a cadastral-map/cadastral-survey complaint contact. It links Tianditu Xianning, the planning public map, and the official land-trading system.

officialSources.publisher: Hubei Provincial Department of Natural Resources
officialSources.observation: Official report says Xianning built a property one-map system from historical property data, uses cadastral survey results and real-estate unit codes, and has an intelligent cadastral-information query tool. This is internal workflow/custodian evidence, not anonymous parcel geometry.

officialSources.publisher: Hubei Provincial Department of Natural Resources
officialSources.observation: Official report says the new Tianditu Xianning platform aggregates land, mineral, and territorial-planning thematic data and offers public map/service functions. It does not document an open cadastral parcel layer or API schema.

requests.method: POST form via curl, anonymous session, safe query fields only
requests.outcome: Alias TDGPZYLB with district 421200 and land category/method filters returned a bounded JSON response containing 297 public land-trading resource records. Some records included ZYID and ZYZB polygon data, but the response also contained transaction, land-use, price, date, and counterparty fields; those unsafe/source-specific fields were not retained. The response is public land-resource/auction data, not verified cadastral registry coverage, and no GeoJSON sample was retained.

No open cadastral parcel feature service was verified.

remainingUncertainty: The local cadastral and registration custodian is clear, and Xianning has current official geospatial/property-map initiatives. The public Tianditu and planning-map routes timed out in this attempt; the land-trading API exposed public transaction geometries but not a cadastral schema, CRS, parcel coverage boundary, or stable cadastral identity semantics. No credentials, private tokens, unsafe property/person fields, CAPTCHA bypass, or TLS exception was used.
